Package dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav

Class DavModule

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.DavModule
All Implemented Interfaces:
Module, RouteHook
public final class DavModule extends Object implements Module, RouteHook
WebDAV for an app: what its Dav mounts share in memory (the space of each storage, dead properties), the check of their routes at boot, and the OPTIONS answer Windows needs above a mount. 

 App.create()
     .install(new SecurityModule(), new BasicAuth(accounts::find), new DavModule())
     .scan("com.acme");

Windows asks OPTIONS / of the server before it uses a share at any path, and gives up on a 404 or 401. So OPTIONS on the root and on every path above a mount is answered with DAV: 1, 2 and nothing else, before any authentication; an app's own OPTIONS route on such a path wins, and a CORS preflight passes through. Install this module before any use that authenticates every request.
